LESSON: GRAMM AR IN USE 9.3.1 ADVERBS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade six
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Gramm ar in Use 9.3.1 Adverbs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Gramm ar in Use 9.3.1 Adverbs, part of Strand 9 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade six ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do we show where, how, when and how many times an action occurs? 2) How do we identify adverbs in written texts?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify adverbs in oral and written texts,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Gramm ar in Use 9.3.1 Adverbs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use adverbs to express different meanings correctly,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Gramm ar in Use 9.3.1 Adverbs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. judge the appropriateness of adverbs used in oral and written texts. ● Learner is guided to identify the adverbs of manner, time, place and frequency in a text. ● Learners with low vision are guided to underline the adverbs in a passage, learners with blindness identify adverbs in passage and read to their group members. ● Learners are guided in small groups to pick out different adverbs from print/ braille texts or the internet using digital devices with assistive technology. ● In groups, learners are guided to judge the correctness of sentences featuring adverbs. ● Learners are guided to form sentences using adverbs. ● Learner is guided to create a poem or story using different types of adverbs. ● In pairs, learners with low vision are guided to create and solve crossword puzzles using adverbs while learners with blindness search for adverbs from a crossword puzzle horizontally and vertically. 1) How do we show where, how, when and how many times an action occurs? 2) How do we identify adverbs in written texts?

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Gramm ar in Use 9.3.1 Adverbs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Gramm ar in Use 9.3.1 Adverbs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
